The '''Expansion Region''', originally known as the '''Expanded Rim''',<ref name="TRG2">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref><ref name="EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> was located between the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
The region was an experiment in corporate-controlled worlds settled in the [[Pre-Republic era]]. Unrelenting exploitation by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]]/[[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] interests of the worlds of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] had impoverished countless native species and contributed to environmental despoliation while their resources fed the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. Galactic colonization of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] was forced to shift further northward, towards the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. Subsequently, a new colonization wave followed beyond, to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], the two galactic powerhouses [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] still looked for untapped resource-rich worlds, and each one sponsored separately the exploration and settlement of the region. Competing economic interests between Alsakan and Coruscant led to the [[First Alsakan Conflict]] in [[17,000 BBY]] which ended the economic boom of the Great Manifest period. Over the following millennia, the competing holdings of both worlds fought seventeen "[[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]]" in the Region. The conflicts devastated many Alsakan colonies; the survivors fell victims to the entry of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] and [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] slavers.<ref name="TEA" />

Only the Corellian Run escaped the conflict due to the strong presence of Corellian military warships, which precipitated further colonization west of the Run. Gradually, the southern portion of the region became part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]], a collective name of prosperous agrarian, industrial and trading worlds, and attracted billions of settlers. The widespread prosperity of this region funded Coruscant's colonization of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] worlds.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Brentaal League]] extended its hyperlanes into the Region in [[4020 BBY]]. The last Alsakan Conflict ended in Coruscant's favor in [[3017 BBY]] and sealed its monopoly over galactic colonization efforts in the ensuing period. For another millennium, the eastern Slice sectors recovered but were devastated by the [[New Sith Wars]] and the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] during the [[Draggulch Period]] ([[2000 BBY/Legends|2000]]&mdash;[[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]). Many colonies were abandoned as the Republic retreated coreward.<ref name="TEA" />

Following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], the Republic granted the [[Expansionist Oligarchy/Legends|Expansionist Oligarchy]], a conglomerate of powerful corporations, control of the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]]. These corporations exploited and profited heavily from the raw materials, metals and ores of many worlds. While profits were enormous for these corporations, the region was plagued by internal strife and disturbances. Inhabitants were oppressed while the corporations stripped entire stellar systems of all their resources. Because they controlled communications and transportation to, from, and across the region, very few people knew what was going on in the Expansion Region.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Expregion2.jpg|thumb|The [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of the Expansion Region circa [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], as reorganized by the Galactic Empire.]]
With civil unrest spreading from system to system, the Republic eventually took control of the Region due to mounting pressure from its denizens by limiting or evicting corporate interests. Though most of those corporations moved on to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] in [[490 BBY]], Expansion Region worlds were still producers of raw materials and ores. However, most natural resources were exhausted. For the following centuries whole astrographic areas of the Region were depopulated and impoverished, dominated by Neimoidians, Hutts and criminals. Such words became home of hermits and outlaws. [[Hyperspace route/Legends|Hyperspace routes]] crossing the Region also were erased over time.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to revive the Slice sectors by developing several key regional centers like [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]], [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]] and [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]] into depot stations for civilian and military fleets and encouraging colonization of surrounding systems by corporations and laborers. The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] also aided in the development of several subsectors and controlled the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]] until the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Slice sectors supported the Empire thanks to the developments it offered; meanwhile, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] found an oportunity in the unfortunate depopulated systems to establish bases. Following the withdrawal of Imperial forces to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] (after the collapse of [[Operation Shadow Hand]]), the Alliance's successor state the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] tried rebuilding the region, gaining popularity in the Slice, but was interrupted by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Though [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agents succeeded in stirring conflict between [[Osarian]] and [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]] along the Corellian Run, much of the region escaped the war.<ref name="TEA" />

==Astrography==
A section of the Region was intersected by [[the Slice/Legends|the Slice]]; as a result of the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] as well as raids of [[piracy/Legends|pirates]] and [[slavery/Legends|slavers]], the worlds near the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], were depopulated and there was a movement of colonization and trade southwards. This resulted to the worlds near the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] (belonging to [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] interests) being thickly settled, and the creation of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to an email from Jason Fry, the Essential Atlas Online Companion's next update would feature a sector map of the Expansion Region. Such an update eventually occurred in late October of 2012.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:Jason Fry email 1.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2012-06-26}}</ref>
